body: Our favourite meal so far! Tastes amazing!!
Big fan of the ragu, the meat is so tender and the sweet potatoe mash complements the dish so well!
Light, crispy, tasty!! I really enjoyed this one lilly. Thankyou, you’ve made lunches and dinner so much easier and healthier 🫶🏽
The bolognese on this spag bol is the most delicious flavoursome sauce i’ve tasted. Will definitely be ordering more of this!  It’s a yes from the Kids as well ! Yum 😋
Yum!!! quick, easy to grab and delicious for those on-the-go days!!  it all tasted fresh from the wrap, to the salad to the chicken. yum!!

Hands down the Ready made fresh meal i’ve ever had. Absolutely delicious. Beef was soft and tender just melts in your mouth with the complimenting taste and texture of the sweet potato! 🤤  My favourite so far. Good portion size, not too little, not too heavy. PERFECTION. Sorry i demolished it before taking a photo- heres the proof 🤭
This is one of my new favourites from Lunches Lily! Super fresh and delicious ingredients and the beef ragu was so beautifully cooked and so full of flavour!!
So much flavour and the meat is so tender and juicy!! I think I have a new favourite
Really enjoyed the new Chicken Chipotle Wrap! Super tasty, full of flavour and has a nice little kick to it. Would definitely get it again!
So easy to prep, and so yum! The sauce packed a real punch and really compliments the wrap
This wrap taste so so good!! So much flavour and is the perfect quick and easy meal!!
Lily has done it again! So flavorsome, the spices on the chicken are wonderful, coleslaw is perfect and the pickle was a great surprise! One of my new faves
The first meal I’ve ever tried from lunches by Lily and it was so delicious! So flavourful and actually super filling. The meat is cooked to perfection too! Love this meal
